segments.text: Hey everyone! Batch 3 mein, daily allowance aur claims seek hinge. Fokus hai central government
civilian official travel. Example, level 7 officer train, hotel aur food alak chek karein. Har
example, hypothetical hai. Latest order aur sanction verify karein. Eek important correction.
Pehle batches mein ye train order miss hua tha. 30 August 2023 ka DOE order chek karein.
Vandebharat ki entitlement shatabdi jaisi hai, Hamsafar ki entitlement rajdhani jaisi
hai. Ye tour, training, transfer aur retirement journeys par apply hota hai. Example, level 7
ke liye eligible chair card chek karein.
Food component ke liye bill submit nahi karene hote.
Har calendar day ki absence se percentage tha hote hain.
6 hours se kum par 30%, 6 se 12 par 70, 12 hour se upar 100%.
Example, level 7 par 7 hours ka food saath so rupah hain.
Absence midnight se midnight, har din alag count hoti hain.
Example, level 7 tour rath 8 se subhe 5 tak hai.
Pehle din 4 hours, agle din 5 hours hain.
Dono par 30%, yani 300 plus 300.
Total food component 600 rupees hoga. Baaki conditions check karein.
Agar boarding aur lodging do no free hon, special rule dekhayin. Purana 25% daily allowance
bandh hai. Eligible local travel par kharch ho to rules ke according claim ho sakta hai.
Example, official city ride mein 200 rupee kharch huay. Entitlement aur proof check karke
vahi actual expense claim karein. Lekin sirf free breakfast ko do no free maanna
sahi nahi hai. Partial meals ke liye is order se fixed percentage assume na karein. Example,
hotel breakfast free hai dinner khud pe kya. Specific applicable instruction accounts
office se konform karein.
Hotel ceiling ek maximum hai, automatic payment nahi. Level 8 tak general rule mein self-certification
available hai. Example, level 7 ka eligible room cost Rs. 800 hai. Tab room claim Rs.
800 hai. Pura ceiling nahi. Class X city ki higher limit ke liye vouchers chahiye. Hotel
taxes entitlement ke upar reimburse ho sakti hai. GST actual charge ke eligible history
par calculate hota hai. Example, artso room aur hypothetical 12% tax. Tax Chianve, total
art su chianve. Conditions lagu. Actual GST rate aur invoice account se check karen.
Level 9-11 ke city travel mein voucher waver hai.
Self-certification mein travel period aur vehicle number likhein.
Example, level 10 officer ki eligible non-AC ride 350 hai.
Claim actual kharj ke liye hai, ceiling ki fixed payment nahi.
Ek purani clarification mein airport transfers alag discuss hai.
Lekin uska aaj ka application accounts office se verify karein.
Example, airport se hotel aur hotel se meeting alag rides hai.
Ek hi ride ko do baar claim mat karein.
Local journey mein normal duty points se distance chek karein. Government training material 8 km radius ka test batata hai.
Example, temporary office normal office se 8 km ke bahar hai.
Ghar se distance deek kar hi final decision mat lein. Example, level 7 aur 7 hours par amount 350.
Lekin original 2018 letter ki verified copy nahi mili. Isli ye actual claim se pehle account se confirm karein.
Specific scientific and data collection field work ke liye clause hai. Rate food component ke equivalent hosakta hai.
Head of department ya controlling officer ka approval zeroori hai. Example, remote survey mein team foot ya mule se jaah rahi hai.
Har ship journey ko automatic extra payment mad samjhen. Foot journey ke liye base rate 12 rupee per kilometre tha.
Pahale 25% increase ke baat 15 rupee hota hai. Example, eligible journey mein 4 kilometre sach mein paye dal chale.
4 into 15 yaani 60 rupee. Conditions check karein.
Claim pack mein sanction, level, journey dates aur tickets rakhe. Hotel aur city travel ke
rules alag hai. Example, level 10 hotel receipt rakhe, city ride self-certify karein. Food
component ke liye alag food vouchers nahi chahiye. Submit karne ka acknowledgement bhi
samhal kar rakhe. Tour ka boarding pass missing hotu prescribe declaration dekhain.
Level 10 aur niche controlling officer counter sign karte hai. Example, level 10
officer form bharkar counter sign karwai. Actual journey aur no duplicate claim
honestly declare karein.
Tour, transfer and training claim ki limit 60 days hai.
Retirement claim ke liye order ne 180 days kiye.
Journey ke baad, agle din se clock shuru hone ka rule dekhayin.
Example, 1 March tour end ho, claim 2 March due hota hai.
Last day ka weight na karein, late claim per forfeiture hosakta hai.
Apna controlling officer hone par treasury ya cash section dekhayin.
Baaki cases mein head of office ya controlling officer ko submit karein.
Example, officer ne samay par head of office ko clean diya.
Dated acknowledgement se submission ki date prove hosakti hai.
Eek saalsi zyada abiens ka review automatic waiver nahi hai.
Toor advance liya hai to ek alag deadline chek karen.
Compendium rule 51 mein 15 days adjustment likha hai.
Toor complete ya uske baat duty resume honeki date dekhain.
Example, advance wala officer jaldi adjustment bill submit karein.
Late hone par recovery ya interest laksakta hai.
Dearness allowance 50% hone par kuch rates bade.
Example, level 7 food 800 se 1000 hua.
60% DA aate hi 2sra increase automatikli nahi hota.
